QF.id: SIA Case Studies on SAS Standards_9

question.text: Per the current SIA workbook (January 2026, pp.37, 57, 59, 109, 111, 126), under which body do Social Impact Assessors register as an SRO, and what other SEBI-specified agencies are recognised?

answer.text: Only ICAI through its Social Impact Assessment Standards Board (SIAB) — no other SROs are recognised
Only ICSI (Institute of Company Secretaries of India)

The Institute of Social Auditors of India (ISAI) under the aegis of ICAI, or other SEBI-specified agencies such as ICMAI's Social Auditors Organisation (ICMAI SAO) and ICSI's Institute of Social Auditors (ISA)
SEBI itself through a dedicated Impact-Assessor division

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the current SIA workbook, Social Impact Assessors register with an SRO under ICAI or other SEBI-specified agencies. Page 59 names the Institute of Social Auditors of India under ICAI, and page 37 notes that ICMAI SAO and ICSI ISA are also SEBI-specified SROs for Social Auditors / Social Impact Assessors. The Trap: Naming "ICAI through SIAB" as the sole notified SRO is the most common distractor — the current workbook names ISAI under ICAI rather than SIAB, and lists ICMAI SAO and ICSI ISA as additional SEBI-specified SROs. Cross-Exam Context: NISM XXIII Ch 2 (Ecosystem) tests the SRO landscape; III-A/III-C Compliance cross-reference SRO oversight.
